items.title: Cohomology on the pro-etale site is computed by the total complex of a hypercovering with weakly contractible terms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a bounded below complex on the pro-etale site of a scheme and a hypercovering whose terms are weakly contractible objects, the derived global sections are computed by the total complex of the alternating complex of sections (statement lines 3282-3293). The proof (proof lines 3295-3327) handles a single sheaf through the Cech spectral sequence and the vanishing over weakly contractible objects, then passes to bounded below complexes through an injective resolution compared by a double complex spectral sequence. H2: two steps with three inputs, written out in full.
